const (
	MaxContextBytes           = 256 << 10
	MaxModelRequestBytes      = 4 << 20
	MaxResponseBytes          = 16 << 20
	MaxFetchRequestBytes      = 4 << 20
	MaxFetchBodyBytes         = 1 << 20
	MaxFetchResponseBodyBytes = 4 << 20
	MaxAuditBytes             = 64 << 10
	MaxEscalationBytes        = 64 << 10
	MaxReferenceBytes         = 16 << 10
)

const (
	OpContext uint32 = iota + 1
	OpModel
	OpFetch
	OpEscalation
	OpAudit
	OpReferenceRead
	OpReferenceSearch
	OpHistory
	OpScript
)

const MaxScriptBytes = 64 << 10

const MaxScriptResultBytes = 1 << 20

const Version uint32 = 1

func (buffer *boundedBuffer) Write(data []byte) (int, error)

func (r ScriptRequest) Validate() error

func (r ScriptResult) Validate() error

func (v HistoryPage) Validate(r HistoryRequest) error

func (v HistoryRequest) Validate() error

func (v ReferenceRead) Validate() error

func (v ReferenceResult) ValidateRead(r ReferenceRead) error

func (v ReferenceResult) ValidateSearch(r ReferenceSearch) error

func (v ReferenceSearch) Validate() error

func (value AuditEvent) Validate() error

func (value Context) Validate() error

func (value EscalationRequest) Validate() error

func (value EscalationResult) Validate() error

func (value FetchRequest) Validate() error

func (value FetchResult) Validate() error

func (value ModelRequest) Validate() error

func (value ModelResponse) Validate() error

func Decode(data []byte, limit int, value any) error

func Encode(value any, limit int) ([]byte, error)

func GuestPath(value string) bool

func Identity(value string) bool

func Text(value string) bool

import "errors"

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"

	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/go/sdk/llm/wire"
)

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/go/sdk/llm/wire"
)

import (
	"errors"
	"github.com/QuincySx/Alva/go/sdk/llm/wire"
)

type AuditEvent struct {
	Version   uint32          `json:"version"`
	Kind      string          `json:"kind"`
	CallID    string          `json:"call_id,omitempty"`
	Tool      string          `json:"tool,omitempty"`
	IsError   bool            `json:"is_error,omitempty"`
	Summary   string          `json:"summary,omitempty"`
	Truncated bool            `json:"truncated,omitempty"`
	Payload   json.RawMessage `json:"payload,omitempty"`
}

type Context struct {
	Version       uint32 `json:"version"`
	SessionID     string `json:"session_id"`
	Workspace     string `json:"workspace"`
	Task          string `json:"task"`
	SystemPrompt  string `json:"system_prompt"`
	MaxIterations int    `json:"max_iterations"`
	Policy        Policy `json:"policy"`

	Attachments      []wire.Reference `json:"attachments,omitempty"`
	HistoryAvailable bool             `json:"history_available,omitempty"`

	ScriptAvailable bool `json:"script_available,omitempty"`
}

type EscalationRequest struct {
	Version   uint32 `json:"version"`
	Command   string `json:"command"`
	Cwd       string `json:"cwd"`
	TimeoutMS uint64 `json:"timeout_ms"`
}

type EscalationResponse struct {
	Stdout   string `json:"stdout"`
	Stderr   string `json:"stderr"`
	ExitCode int    `json:"exit_code"`
}

type EscalationResult struct {
	Version  uint32              `json:"version"`
	Response *EscalationResponse `json:"response,omitempty"`
	Error    string              `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type FetchRequest struct {
	Version uint32   `json:"version"`
	Method  string   `json:"method"`
	URL     string   `json:"url"`
	Headers []Header `json:"headers"`
	Body    []byte   `json:"body,omitempty"`
}

type FetchResponse struct {
	Status  int      `json:"status"`
	Headers []Header `json:"headers"`
	Body    []byte   `json:"body,omitempty"`
}

type FetchResult struct {
	Version  uint32         `json:"version"`
	Response *FetchResponse `json:"response,omitempty"`
	Error    string         `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type Header struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Value string `json:"value"`
}

type HistoryEntry struct {
	Sequence  uint64         `json:"sequence"`
	Namespace string         `json:"namespace"`
	Type      string         `json:"type"`
	Summary   string         `json:"summary"`
	Value     wire.Reference `json:"value"`
	Snippet   string         `json:"snippet,omitempty"`
}

type HistoryPage struct {
	Version   uint32         `json:"version"`
	Entries   []HistoryEntry `json:"entries"`
	Next      uint64         `json:"next"`
	HighWater uint64         `json:"high_water"`
	HasMore   bool           `json:"has_more"`
}

type HistoryRequest struct {
	Version   uint32 `json:"version"`
	Query     string `json:"query,omitempty"`
	After     uint64 `json:"after"`
	HighWater uint64 `json:"high_water"`
	Limit     int    `json:"limit"`
}

type ModelRequest struct {
	Version  uint32                `json:"version"`
	Messages []wire.Message        `json:"messages"`
	Tools    []wire.ToolDefinition `json:"tools"`
	Config   wire.ModelConfig      `json:"config"`
}

type ModelResponse struct {
	Version uint32             `json:"version"`
	Chunks  []wire.StreamChunk `json:"chunks"`
}

type Policy struct {
	AllowFileWrite         bool `json:"allow_file_write"`
	AllowEscalationRequest bool `json:"allow_escalation_request"`
}

type ReferenceRead struct {
	Version uint32 `json:"version"`
	URI     string `json:"uri"`
	Offset  int64  `json:"offset"`
	Limit   int    `json:"limit"`
}

type ReferenceResult struct {
	Version uint32      `json:"version"`
	Page    *TextPage   `json:"page,omitempty"`
	Matches []TextMatch `json:"matches,omitempty"`
}

type ReferenceSearch struct {
	Version uint32 `json:"version"`
	URI     string `json:"uri"`
	Query   string `json:"query"`
	Limit   int    `json:"limit"`
}

type ScriptRequest struct {
	Version uint32 `json:"version"`
	Script  string `json:"script"`
}

type ScriptResult struct {
	Version uint32   `json:"version"`
	Result  string   `json:"result"`
	Output  []string `json:"output"`
	Error   string   `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type TextMatch struct {
	URI    string `json:"uri"`
	Text   string `json:"text"`
	Offset int64  `json:"offset"`
}

type TextPage struct {
	URI        string `json:"uri"`
	Text       string `json:"text"`
	Offset     int64  `json:"offset"`
	NextOffset int64  `json:"next_offset"`
	TotalBytes int64  `json:"total_bytes"`
	Truncated  bool   `json:"truncated"`
}
